spanish: Y pasó Jehová sobre sus faces, y llamó: Jehová, Jehová, Dios clemente y misericordioso, largo de narices y mucho de misericordia y verdad,

findings.issue: H7349 (compassionate) precedes H2587 (gracious); «clemente» fits the gracious adjective and «misericordioso» the compassionate one, so the Spanish order may reverse the two tokens.

notes: Remaining Spanish matches the tokens, including the dual nostrils kept as narices and both construct phrases.
